summary: Digi Power X Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an upsized at-the-market offering (ATM) of up to $175M in subordinate voting shares, replacing a prior $75M ATM of which ~$72.4M had been sold. No specific price, premium, or board recommendation is provided as this is an ongoing shelf takedown, not a fixed-price special situation. The filing includes a prospectus supplement, legal opinion from MLT Aikins LLP, and a Canadian material change report. As a routine capital markets transaction without control or structural event, this does not constitute a special situation category.
